notes.title: Upcoming Release ‘Precipice’ Now Available to Wishlist on Steam!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28039338/e8299cd86648c56d129450ef2287c8c96df91494.png

We’re excited to share with fans of Deep Sixed our next title Precipice; a tense turn-based strategy game of subterfuge for 1-2 players that’s set to launch in 2019 for Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms on Steam -- wishlist today to receive notification when the game releases later this year!

Precipice trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ri0Pc5xvJkM
Gameplay video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3cBQouCGbs

We’re currently targeting late Winter / early Spring for release, and plan on putting together some testing opportunities to check out pre-release versions of Precipice. For those interested, we encourage you to sign-up for our newsletter on our website to receive announcements and updates on the game.

- The LRDGames Team

Join us on our Discord: https://discord.gg/DE939dE
Follow us on Twitter: @LRDGames

notes.title: Deep Sixed Release Day Is Here!
notes.notes:
Phew, the game is finally released!  Now everyone can experience the dystopian space survival nightmare that we have unleashed upon the cosmos.

Thanks to you all for your patience, we'll be hanging around the community as much as we can to answer any questions, or comments, suggestions etc. 

In the meantime, have fun!

notes.title: Deep Sixed NEW EARLY RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Usually, when a developer updates their fans about a game's release date, it's to deliver bad news.  This isn't that kind of announcement.

You guys have given us all so much momentum these past few weeks, and the feedback we've received has been uplifting.  We want you all to finally be able to play this game, and to be honest...we just can't wait anymore!  So we've bumped our release date by a couple weeks to February 12th.  We're looking forward to seeing your adventures as you explore the mysteries of the MG251 nebula.  Good hunting!

notes.title: Deep Sixed Release Date Set
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Deep Sixed will be in your hands in just nine weeks.  Our release date is set for February 27th, 2018!

We're really excited to be at this point.  If you're just joining us now on this journey, Deep Sixed is a truly one-of-a-kind space survival game that will keep you glued to your heads-up-display as you try to survive mapping deep a mysterious nebula.  While other games might have you play the role of the stalwart space-captain righting the injustices of the universe, Deep Sixed is a love-letter to the Scotty’s, Geordi’s and O’Brien’s who are out there with just a space-wrench and a roll of duct tape trying to keep the radiation scrubber from falling apart.
